title: VIX futures and options November 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — shares its session with the October FOMC minutes, and is the first tracked expiration whose 30-day reference window contains Thanksgiving and a full SEP decision
source: EST: THE VENUE'S OWN RULE AND THE PUBLISHER'S OWN CALENDAR, BOTH RE-FETCHED AND RE-DERIVED IN-SESSION 2026-09-08 BY THIS EVENT'S INITIAL RESEARCH -- nothing inherited from the proposal. THE RULE, APPLIED COLD: Cboe's VX final-settlement clause is the Wednesday 30 days prior to the third Friday of the month immediately following the contract month, displaced to the preceding business day if that Wednesday or the Friday 30 days after it is an exchange holiday. For the November 2027 contract (VX/X7): December 2027's third Friday is 2027-12-17, the Wednesday 30 days prior is 2027-11-17, and neither leg is a closure -- the statute-derived 2027 closure set (Jan 1, Jan 18, Feb 15, Mar 26, May 31, Jun 18, Jul 5, Sep 6, Nov 25, Dec 24) puts nothing on either date, so the clause does not fire. THE RULE'S OWN VALIDATION, re-implemented independently this session: 218 rule-derived monthly settlements 2008-07 through 2026-08 against Cboe's own final-settlement series cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VRO_History.csv (HTTP 200, 26,597 bytes, 1,268 rows, 2008-07-16 to 2026-09-02) reproduce 217 of 218, the single absence being 2013-05-22, for which Cboe's file carries no May-2013 row at any date; all six holiday displacements in range are recovered (2014-03-18, 2019-03-19, 2022-03-15, 2024-06-18, 2025-03-18, 2026-05-19). THE PUBLISHER: the Options Industry Council's backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes, 155 dated rows), an artifact of The Options Clearing Corporation, carries a 2027-11-17 row whose GUID resolves in the document's own legend to 'Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date' -- read directly, not derived. WHY THIS ENTRY STAYS ESTIMATE: VX/X7 IS NOT LISTED. Cboe's settlement surface (www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv, HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes, 56 rows) stops at VX/K7 2027-05-18 and VXM/G7 2027-02-17; a scan of all 56 rows returns zero X7 contracts. Every OCC:-prefixed promotion in this class rested on the specific contract appearing on that surface. PROMOTION TRIGGER: VX/X7 appearing on a Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar surface dated 2027-11-17. THE SIBLING'S PUBLISHER WARNING IS NARROWED RATHER THAN INHERITED: vix-expiration-2027-10-20 recorded this same OIC/OCC calendar as off by a week at its own 2027-12-15 (rule: 2027-12-22), and this session reproduces that exactly -- 35 of its 36 volatility rows match the rule. But of those 36 rows, EXACTLY ONE has its own reference third Friday absent from the same file: 2027-12-15, whose +30-day anchor 2028-01-14 falls past the file's 2027-12-31 end. 2027-11-17's own anchor, 2027-12-17, IS published in the same file as a third-Friday 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date' row. The publisher's single demonstrated error is its single anchorless row; this row is anchored. That strengthens the date without promoting the status, which turns on the listing and not on the calendar. Discovered during the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research; canonical file written by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-11-17.md), checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research 2026-09-08 after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/vix-expiration-2027-11-17.from-fomc-minutes-2027-11-17.json. THE PROPOSAL'S CENTRAL FINDING IS REPRODUCED AND THEN CONFOUNDED, which is this ledger's deliverable. The proposal carried the fomc-minutes lane's split of the family's VIX-down statistic by whether the release shares its session with the monthly VIX settlement -- 71.0 percent off-settlement against 50.0 percent on-settlement, p = 0.0122 -- and asked this lane to own the settlement half. Re-derived here from an independent parse of 160 minutes releases 2007-02-21 to 2026-08-19 (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm plus the fourteen historical year pages, all HTTP 200) and the exact settlement engine above, the split REPRODUCES: 50.0 percent VIX-down on the 46 collisions against 70.2 percent on the 114 non-collision releases, -20.2pp at P = 0.019 on 20,000 permutations. THREE MEASUREMENTS THEN TAKE THE MECHANISM AWAY. (1) THERE IS NO SETTLEMENT MAIN EFFECT TO DO THE KILLING. All 217 realized settlements close VIX down 53.9 percent of the time; settlements without minutes run 55.0 percent (n=171) against 54.1 percent for sessions that are neither (n=4,274) -- +0.8pp at P = 0.876. From the settlement's own side the split is null: 50.0 percent against 55.0 percent, P = 0.615. A settlement day is an ordinary day for VIX direction. (2) THE COLLISION LABEL IS A PROXY FOR THE CALENDAR MONTH. 44 of the 78 Feb/May/Aug/Nov minutes releases collide with a settlement; only 2 of the other 82 do. Splitting the same 160 releases by month slot alone gives 53.8 percent against 74.4 percent, -20.5pp at P = 0.0080 -- LARGER and MORE significant than the collision split. Within the Feb/May/Aug/Nov slot the collision split collapses to 47.7 percent against 61.8 percent, -14.0pp at P = 0.261. (3) THE FAMILY OF SPLITS IS RIDDLED WITH HITS. Of 14 arbitrary calendar splits of the same releases, 3 clear P < 0.05 (settlement day 0.019, Feb/May/Aug/Nov 0.008, day-of-month above 15 0.049) with third-Wednesday at 0.051, against roughly 0.7 expected -- because these predicates are near-collinear. AND THE SETTLEMENT ITSELF IS UNMOVED. Against the 171 non-collision settlements, the 46 collisions are null on all four contemporaneous measures at 100,000 permutations -- VRO vs prior close P = 0.240, VIX open vs prior close P = 0.312, the SOQ's own basis to the same session's open P = 0.456, close vs VRO P = 0.291 -- and null on forward accuracy, where VRO minus realized close-to-close SPX vol over the contract's own 30-day window runs +2.78 points on collisions against +4.30 elsewhere (P = 0.280), LOWER rather than higher, with an identical 85 percent overprice rate in both arms. STRUCTURE, carried forward not acted on. This settlement is OUTSIDE any FOMC blackout (the October gate closes 2027-10-28, the December gate opens 2027-11-27), making it only the third of nine tracked expirations outside one -- the framing three siblings were built on does not apply here. Its 30-day reference window runs 2027-11-17 to 2027-12-17: 23 weekdays less the Thanksgiving closure 2027-11-25 leaves 22 trading sessions, the first tracked VIX window to contain the one US closure with an adjacent half-session, and it contains fomc-2027-12-08 at +21 -- the year's final SEP decision -- plus fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 at +10, consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 and fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 at +13. A METHOD GOTCHA THIS SESSION MEASURED AND RECORDS FOR THE CLASS: Cboe's VIX_History.csv is NOT a trading-day file. It carries full OHLC rows on US exchange closures -- verified on Thanksgiving 2025-11-27, Memorial Day 2026-05-25, Juneteenth 2024-06-19, the 2025-01-09 Carter-funeral closure, Independence Day observed 2026-07-03 and Labor Day 2026-09-07 -- while omitting New Year's Day and Christmas. Running the settlement engine off that file's implied calendar instead of statute scores 215 of 218 and loses two of the six holiday displacements; both runs were performed this session, which is how the difference is known rather than assumed. Impact low, matching every other vix-expiration entry. symbols is empty; trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ and return ZERO hits in both, so no house playbook is calendar-, expiration- or settlement-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
